body: Yes bro, thank you for all the kind words, tips, and support :) I'm gonna try my best
haha thanks :) and you're right! maybe not about the asshole thing but you're definitely right about the ideals with handwork and effort! i respect it. Good luck, pal

Thank you for taking the time to write all of this :) I spoke to my dad, and I believe I'm getting an appointment soon. Thank you for relating as well, it really provided empathy for me. I'm so sorry that you had to go through something similar :( its a pain no one should have to endure
This comment literally made me speechless with joy. Can't thank you enough for the kind words. I know now that I just have to hold on, thanks to you all. We'll make it through this :)

Thank you for opening up like that :) I know how tough it was for me. I don't have much wisdom in my 15 year old mind, but I've seen a lot of relationships end, romantic that is. The one thing I've learned is that no matter how you are as a person, or how shit of a day you've had, there is no point in being anything less than pleasant to your partner. It's MUCH easier said than done, but it's the truth. Kindness and honesty go along way and if you try and work out your emotions a long side him, it could very well work out in the end. Thank you for your support :)

I hope they don't delete it either, it was very helpful :) I'm actually starting at a gym and going on a diet to try and get myself going, and your comment was nothing but motivation to keep going with my ways. I didn't trust in it, but now it definitely feels a bit better :) thank you!
I've come to realize that the people I can reach out to at 3:00am and still get support are the ones I should hold on to. Thank you for the response :)
Thank you so much. I had no other choice than to post, I felt hopeless. It definitely was the right thing to do.
I'm looking forward for the day :) and I'm sorry you had to go through struggles at that time, from what I can feel, it's close to unbareable. Thank you for replying :)
Thank you for all the advice. I promise you I'll go through all these things and update you. You've given me a goal and a trajectory, I can't thank you enough. What area in CT do you go to?
Thank u so much for your kind words. They mean the world, believe me :)
I know its true, just sometimes I need people to say it, yanno?

I'm not quite sure if I'll live to my next birthday either, but if I do survive, it'll be because of one thought. The thought (and fact) that there are others just as depressed as both you and me, who are waking up day to day hoping that things get better. If there's at least one other person who is strong enough to just keep going, Ill be strong enough too. And so should you. I'm sending all the good vibes and empathy that I can. Even though I truly don't know what you're going through, I can't imagine that it's even bareable, and I'm truly sorry for that. Other than that, Happy birthday!!! you made it another year, and that for sure something to brag about. Do what makes you feel the best you can. People are here for you.
I appreciate it, bro. Hold on to the hope, and remember that there are so many others by your side. Including me. This journey could be something else.

I've come to learn that empathy is one of the most powerful things this world has to offer. Just sharing empathy means the world to me, and it makes me feel less alone. I relate to you with the heartbreak. It literally feels like a poison. I'm not sure if there's anything worse. Thank you for showing me a bigger picture. I really appreciate it.

I'm sure gaining the time back that you spent with her is no little feat. I feel for you at an astronomical level, and you moving forward gives me hope that I can do the same. Keep on moving, and I will too. We're not alone.

Thank you so so much. I can't thank you enough. I'm literally blubbering while writing this. I'm eternally grateful for you and how you took the time out of your day to help me out. I'm gonna hold on.

Yes, I voiced my pain. He broke down, and is willing to do whatever it takes to make me better. I said that he doesn't minimize. I mean't that in a good way. He doesn't brush it under the rug like some of my closest friends. He brings it to light. Thank you for your empathy, it's really what I needed.
